# Evidence from real products

Screens found through Mobbin and what each teaches. **adopt** means copy the pattern, **watch-out** means it breaks a rule and is kept as a counter-example. These are observations of other products for pattern research, not templates to copy visually.

KPI tiles carry '100% vs previous'. The in-progress day is a hatched bar. Export CSV sits above the tables. | Presets first, custom range second. Hatch the incomplete period. ## Watch-outs

| Id | Product and screen | What it does | Lesson | Rules |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `[MOB-01]` | [Cofounder](https://mobbin.com/screens/2f7a876a-0cb0-4ec2-b47b-e2c6f119f566): Daily activity line chart with dots and a small tooltip | A smoothed spline dips toward zero between two real points and overshoots near the peaks. Title plus a date-range subtitle and a compact tooltip (date, value) are good. | Smoothing invents values between points. Use linear or monotone. Keep the title and period subtitle and the minimal tooltip. | `[DV-HONEST-005]` `[DV-CONTEXT-001]` `[DV-INTERACT-002]` |
| `[MOB-02]` | [LangChain](https://mobbin.com/screens/b43a980d-6a77-48d5-b764-d697475a157c): Monitoring dashboard with Group by and Last 7 days | Three large cards are flat zero lines with one spike. Legend swatches sit below, each card has an expand icon, and one range control scopes all cards. | Large cards of mostly flat zero waste the page and blur missing data with real zero. Share one range control, but give sparse data its own state. | `[DV-STATE-006]` `[DV-HONEST-008]` `[DV-FILTER-004]` `[DV-CONSIST-002]` `[DV-INTERACT-006]` |
| `[MOB-09]` | [Trello](https://mobbin.com/screens/0dbdb488-1169-4df7-8f8f-95c45a428225): Dark board dashboard with pie and colored bars | A 4-slice pie and a bar chart where each of five bars is a different color (green, yellow, orange, red, gray). A card menu offers Edit and Delete. | Per-bar hues on one series burn the color channel. Status meaning (complete, overdue) is fine only if each also has a label or icon, and red beside green is a CVD trap. Use one hue plus text labels. | `[DV-COLOR-007]` `[DV-COLOR-006]` `[DV-FORM-004]` `[DV-INTERACT-006]` |

| `[MOB-17]` | [Snowflake](https://mobbin.com/screens/465aeb37-a153-449d-b3d3-c81ed1756333): In-worksheet chart builder | A single full-height bar fills its band and a grouped chart fills the whole plot with two saturated blocks. The builder panel for type, data and appearance is clear. | Cap bar thickness and leave air. The type, data and appearance panel structure is a good builder pattern. | `[DV-CLARITY-006]` |
